title: Annotatio VI §.VIII: fight is only Oral/Corporal eating (profits nothing) and Indignorum bread
pass_a_gloss: But only about Oral and Corporal Eating of Christ’s body and Drinking of his Blood, which profit nothing whatever; and about the Eating of the Unworthy, which whether it happen or less happen, is only, according to the Apostle, Eating of blessed bread, not of the body; according to Augustine, bread which is of the Lord, not bread which is the Lord — and draws eternal condemnation to them.
pass_b_english: The fight is only over Oral and Corporal eating and drinking, which profit nothing.
And over Indignorum eating — which, whether it happens or not, is only blessed bread per Paul, bread of the Lord not bread the Lord per Augustine, and draws condemnation.
source_text: Sed de sola Manducatione corporis Christi & Bibitione Sanguinis ejus, Oralibus & Corporalibus, quæ nihil quicquam prosunt; deque Manducatione Indignorum, quæ sive fiat, sive minus fiat, sitque tantum, juxta Apostolum, Manducatio panis benedicti, non corporis; Juxta Augustinum, panis qui est Domini non panis qui est Dominus, æternam iis condemnationem attrahit.

lemmas.latin: panis qui est Domini non … Dominus
lemmas.gloss: bread of the Lord not … the Lord
